svg.aria-label: Authelia versus Authentik as self-hosted single sign-on in 2026. Authelia on the left: one declarative YAML config file, runs as a single container against a SQLite file with no separate database, an OpenID-Certified OIDC provider that is still an open beta with no single sign-out, very low idle memory, best for the smallest footprint. Authentik on the right: a web GUI, a three-service stack of PostgreSQL plus server plus worker with Redis removed in release 2025.10, a documented minimum of 2 CPU cores and 2GB of RAM, the widest protocol coverage including a served LDAP directory and RADIUS, with directory provisioning and compliance features gated behind a paid Enterprise tier. The correction the whole search result misses: Authelia is OpenID Certified and an open beta at the same time.
svg.text: Authelia vs Authentik 2026
Self-hosted SSO. The whole SERP is arguing about a fact that went stale five years ago.
The correction nobody states: Authelia is OpenID Certified AND still an open beta
It has shipped an OIDC provider since v4.29.0 (May 2021). Both halves are true at once — every guide keeps only one.
Authelia
Smallest footprint, one config file
1 container + SQLite file · no database
One declarative YAML config, backs up as a file
OIDC provider: certified, but open BETA
Idle memory a small fraction of Authentik
No single sign-out yet (roadmap, not shipped)
PICK IT FOR
Tiny footprint, version-controlled config, OIDC apps
Authentik
Fuller IdP, GUI, widest protocols
postgres + server + worker · NO Redis (2025.10)
Web GUI · served LDAP directory · RADIUS
Working single logout · self-service reset
Documented minimum: 2 CPU / 2GB RAM
Free tier complete; Enterprise = provisioning
PICK IT FOR
A GUI, breadth, single logout, non-technical users
Two more things every other guide gets wrong
Authentik dropped Redis entirely in 2025.10 — the current stack is three services, not four. Guides still listing it are stale.
Authelia's 30MB-to-1GB memory spread is a CONFIG choice (SQLite vs LDAP+services), not different measurements of one thing.
Versions from the GitHub release APIs; capabilities from authelia.com and goauthentik.io docs read 2026-07-21. Beta status may change. TechFuelHQ.
